These replicate actual product UI for product feature pages. ## Project context - Next.js 16.2.3, TypeScript strict, Framer Motion. Brand `@/lib/brand` (BRAND, FONT) - All `"use client"` (use motion). Strict types — no `any`. `as React.CSSProperties` on inline styles. - Reference pattern (already exists, read for style cues): `src/components/dashboard/dashboard-mockup.tsx` — but the new mockups are FEATURE-SPECIFIC, not the same homepage one. Each must be unique to its product page. ## SHARED chrome (used by all 3 mockups) Each mockup wrapper: ```tsx
{/* Browser chrome */}
inkos.app/{ROUTE}
{/* Sidebar (same across all 3) */} {/* Main (unique per mockup) */}
``` ## SHARED sidebar (extract once, reuse 3x) The onyx sidebar with logo + nav groups + user profile is the same in all 3 mockups, except which item is `active`. Add a sub-component within each mockup file (or copy-paste). Items: - Studio group: Today, Inbox (badge 3), Calendar, Messages (badge 2), Appointments - Workflow group: Projects (NEW tag), Clients, Team - Bottom user card: "Sable & Sparrow / Brooklyn" Pattern (lifted from existing reference): - Sidebar: BRAND.onyx bg color BRAND.bone, padding 20px 14px, flex column gap 4 - Logo row: 26x26 bone square w/ italic "i", "InkOS" text 14/700 - Group label: 9px 0.14em letterSpacing rgba(247,247,245,0.4) 700 padding 2px 8px 6px uppercase - Nav item: flex gap 10 padding 8px 10px borderRadius 7. Active = rgba(247,247,245,0.10) bg, full bone color, 600 weight. Inactive = transparent, rgba(247,247,245,0.7), 500. - Badge (red): BRAND.rust bg bone color 9px 700 1.5px 5.5px padding borderRadius 8 - Tag (NEW): 8px BRAND.rust 0.12em letterSpacing 700 - User card at bottom: padding 10x10 borderRadius 8 rgba(247,247,245,0.06) bg. 24x24 rust gradient avatar + studio name 11/600 + city 9 + ChevronDown. ## FILE 1: `src/components/product/mockups/today-mockup.tsx` Active sidebar item: Today.
